# Monongalia County, West Virginia Genealogy

## County Information

### Description

Monongalia County was named for the Monongahela River. The county is located in the north-central area of the state.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

### County Courthouse

**Monongalia County Courthouse**  
 243 High Street, #123  
Morgantown, WV 26505  
Phone: 304-291-7230  
[Monongalia County Website](http://www.co.monongalia.wv.us/cdir.html)  
  
County clerk has birth and death records from 1853, marriage records from 1796, probate records from early 1800s, land records from 1843.[[2]](#cite_note-2)  
Clerk of the Circuit Court has divorce and court records.[[3]](#cite_note-3)
